key_decisions.rationale: Synoptic parallel ∥ 2KI 19:37 — shipped 2 Kings Thai reused verbatim (chs 36–39 parallel-duty; Hebrew identical). The v. 7 decree's last clause lands (เราจะให้เขาล้มลงด้วยดาบในแผ่นดินของเขาเอง): killed in his god's house BY HIS OWN SONS — the god who couldn't deliver him from his own family; the chapter's theology in one obituary.

translation.notes: The synoptic bridge's war-narrative closes; ch. 38: Hezekiah's illness (∥ 2KI 20:1–11) + the psalm Isaiah alone preserves.
